data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'peteino', meaning 'to prick', and 'ornis', meaning 'bird'. This name, Fauch, is a nod to the little fowl, carrying the symbolism of rebirth and renewal, as well as the courage and loyalty often associated with birds.
